purpose: Typed local run ledger: useful application delivery through a real Next.js/React UI, FastAPI API and PostgreSQL transaction boundary
acceptance: Locked native Python and JavaScript restores succeed in the isolated application directory
Alembic upgrades an empty PostgreSQL18.6 database and repeat upgrade is idempotent
Invalid and extra request fields are rejected before writes
Create and status update write both run state and history in one transaction
A stale revision returns409; database-injected history failure rolls back the run update
An isolated real browser creates a run and changes its status; generated OpenAPI TypeScript types and production Next build pass
The UI-created run survives PostgreSQL stop/start and API process restart
Only owned loopback processes, container and test browser are stopped after verification
limits: Local unauthenticated sample containing synthetic data only
No cloud deployment, accounts, provider/model calls, trading or production operational readiness
Mac arm64 host only unless another host is separately executed
No token-saving claim; whole coordinator usage is unknown
